dataset.name: WANDS 3 real tenants (Water Filter Pitchers, Faux Plants and Trees, Furniture -- same sizes as H6/H7/H8/H9)

engine_config.native: commerce_core::index::CatalogIndex, single-threaded, no concurrent load, /proc/self/stat-based CPU-time accounting

headline_result.h13_status: FALSIFIED -- CPU cost is NOT linear in product count, reproduced across 3 runs
headline_result.scaling_shape: sub-linear from 1 to 5 products (2.74x growth vs 5.0x product-count growth); super-linear from 5 to 16039 products (9694.6x growth vs 3207.8x product-count growth)
headline_result.linear_extrapolation_vs_actual: furniture actual (10534.77 us/query) is 3.81x higher than a straight-line fit through the two small tenants predicts (2767 us/query)
headline_result.disclosed_unconfirmed_mechanism: distinct facet (color) value cardinality growing with tenant size, compounding candidate-count scanning cost -- not profiled or confirmed
